overall_summary: Analysis of 41 Short videos reveals strong performance driven by high-concept visual cosmic events (e.g., Earth having rings, atmosphere loss, sound in space) with top views reaching 700–1,038. Videos utilizing short seamless looping structures achieve average view percentages over 100% to 360%. Conversely, abstract physics or gravity-focused topics experience rapid early audience drop-off in the first 5 seconds.

what_is_working.evidence: Titles featuring visible planetary scale shifts generated peak view counts: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,038 views, 50.7% AVP), 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' (881 views, 64.3% AVP), and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (701 views).
what_is_working.action: Prioritize high-impact astronomical visual transformations that can be immediately shown on screen within the first second.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' achieved 361.81% AVP, and 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' achieved 195.54% AVP, with retention ratios staying above 2.7x-3.5x throughout.
what_is_working.action: Structure short scripts under 20-30 seconds so the concluding sentence seamlessly connects into the opening hook phrase to trigger automatic replay.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' suffered immediate audience drop-off, retaining only ~10% relative retention by 10% video progress (28.2% total AVP). 'What If Earth's Gravity Reversed' similarly dropped to ~13% relative retention at 10% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Replace abstract physics terms ('gravity tripled', 'air pressure doubled') with immediate visual consequences ('buildings floating', 'skyscrapers collapsing').

what_to_improve.evidence: Multiple identical titles were published within seconds of each other (e.g., 'What If Earth Loss Its Magnetic Field?' at 19:39:37Z got 10 views vs 365 views at 19:39:48Z; duplicate 'Saturn Rings' uploads spaced seconds apart).
what_to_improve.action: Enforce strict publishing schedules with a minimum 4-6 hour gap between posts and ensure unique video metadata to avoid internal feed competition.

retention_insights.evidence: Relative retention drops below 0.15 by 5% progress on 'Gravity Tripled' and 'Gravity Reversed', showing viewers swipe away instantly.
retention_insights.action: Hook viewers with immediate action visuals in frame 1 rather than title text overlay or verbal setup.

retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Strong hold zone and high loop retention
retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' maintained an audience watch ratio above 3.54 at 49% progress, yielding 361.81% watch percentage.
retention_insights.action: Use countdown timers on screen and sync the resolution of the '5 second' premise with the end loop.

best_posting_windows.reason: Consistently produced top performing videos including 'Earth Had Rings Like Saturn' (1,038 views at 04:56 UTC) and 'Sound Could Travel Through Space' (701 views at 04:47 UTC).
Driven by the channel's top view performer 'Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds' (881 views at 12:08 UTC) and stable performers around 12:25-12:30 UTC.
